prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 2 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1210; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented for evaluation following a rear-end motor vehicle collision. At the initial visit, they reported neck pain rated 6 out of 10 with stiffness and reduced range of motion, along with lower back pain radiating into the buttocks but not past the knee. Examination showed paraspinal muscle tenderness in the cervical and lumbar regions, mild restriction in cervical rotation and lateral flexion, and intact neurological findings including strength, sensation, and reflexes. Cervical and lumbar X-rays were ordered and showed no fracture or acute bony abnormality. The working diagnosis was cervical and lumbar strain. The patient was advised to use ice and heat, take over-the-counter anti-inflammatory medication as directed, avoid heavy lifting, and perform gentle range-of-motion exercises.

At the follow-up visit, the patient reported modest improvement, with neck pain now rated 4 out of 10 and lower back discomfort reduced. Range of motion had improved, and tenderness was less pronounced. Neurological status remained normal. A home exercise program was reviewed and reinforced, and a return to light daily activity was encouraged with gradual increase as tolerated. Continued conservative management was recommended, with return precautions provided for new numbness, weakness, or worsening pain.
